newsitem.title: NEPAL: Japanese aid for Nepal to boost food, education.
newsitem.headline: Japanese aid for Nepal to boost food, education.

text.p: Japan on Thursday pledged aid worth $12.5 million to help Nepal boost food output and primary education in rural areas, officials said.
They said Tokyo would provide non-refundable grants to buy fertilisers and agricultural equipment to increase food production.
A Finance Ministry statement said the aid would assist a primary education project aimed at improving access to schools for the rural poor.
Nepal, one of the world's 10 poorest countries, receives over 60 percent of the cost of its economic development from Western donors.
Japan, which provides $35 million in annual assistance, is the Himalayan kingdom's largest aid donor.
